subject: Explicit, non-mutating first-run recovery and typed legacy configuration compatibility.

dimensions.desc: Names run initialization, planting, and later spawn as one ordered operator-owned recovery action.
Stops rather than initializing, planting, retrying, or running shepherd init --confirm as a spawn side effect.
Accepts typed legacy paths.reports in ordinary and migration loading while rejecting wrong types with source and dotted-key provenance, without another parser.
Requires authored and generated carrier parity plus a deterministic removal mutation that fails.

guidance: Reward the exact explicit run-init → plant → later-spawn transition, operator ownership, fail-loud typed compatibility, and byte-consistent compiler-owned projections. Penalize silent init/retry, implicit shepherd init --confirm, conflated lifecycle states, wrong-type tolerance, second parsers, hand-edited carriers, and prose-only checks.
